details.contract_guidance: Legacy steps require nonempty expected_state.assertions. For sequential states use action=phased_sequence with phases [{id, actions, assertions}]; each phase needs its own nonempty assertions, while overall expected_state.assertions is optional. Phase actions: click {selector}, fill {selector,value}, submit {selector}, reload {}, open_link {context_key}; include kind in every action. Do not combine phased steps with legacy locator/pre_locator/typed_values. DOM checks use CSS selector; count_equals requires a nonnegative integer value; optional text_equals filters the collection by exact text rather than reading its first node. This only proves DOM cardinality; attribute_equals requires attribute and value. Never conjoin successive screens as one final observation. Run tools/tauri_journey_drive.py --game <candidate> --check for shared static preflight; it does not prove business outcomes. text/value/mail checks also use value, with existing {email}/{task_title} templates. visit_views_and_assert requires view_assertions mapping each navigation selector to its own list. Derive meaningful postconditions from the frozen PRD; keep all required steps and do not change the Host validator. The current Tauri Host registers journey_drive and external_activation; historical notes about their absence do not authorize a waiver. Preserve application probes; collector ownership belongs to Host.

details.contract_guidance: Legacy steps require nonempty expected_state.assertions. For sequential states use action=phased_sequence with phases [{id, actions, assertions}]; each phase needs its own nonempty assertions, while overall expected_state.assertions is optional. DOM checks use CSS selector; count_equals requires a nonnegative integer value; optional text_equals filters the collection by exact text rather than reading its first node.
